description: Website and landing-page launch QA for technical SEO, metadata, indexability, page structure, social previews, and a bounded internal-link sample, paid per completed JSON report through x402.

intents.name: audit_launch_page
intents.description: Audit one public HTTPS website or landing page before launch for technical SEO, title and description metadata, canonical and social tags, meta robots directives, page structure, and a bounded same-host link sample. Returns evidence and suggested fixes as JSON.

url.description: The public HTTPS page to audit.

returns.description: A launch-readiness score, pass/warn/fail counts, evidence-backed checks, prioritized issues, and a bounded link sample.

x402.description: Pay $0.04 USDC per completed audit through x402 on Base or Solana.

intents.name: extract_page_metadata
intents.description: Extract the title, description, canonical, language, viewport, meta robots, favicon, Open Graph, and Twitter Card values declared in the fetched HTML source of one public HTTPS page. Missing declarations are explicit; no JavaScript rendering, asset fetching, link probing, or platform-preview emulation.

url.description: The public HTTPS page whose declared metadata should be extracted.

returns.description: Raw declared metadata values, explicit missing fields, HTTP status, redirects, and the final URL.

x402.description: Pay $0.01 USDC per metadata extraction through x402 on Base or Solana.

intents.name: get_example_audit
intents.description: Inspect a representative ProofDesk audit response without payment.

proofdesk.scope: Source-level launch preflight only; not penetration testing, legal advice, or a complete accessibility certification.
